articles.title: Clarity Act sits idle over Trump ethics question as Warren asks SEC to investigate him
articles.snippet: Senators Elizabeth Warren and Richard Blumenthal requested the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission probe Trump's memecoin.

articles.title: As Clarity Act teeters, mystery group hammers away at crypto in Washington ads
articles.snippet: Crypto Watchdog has taken to warning people in DC about the hazards of digital assets, and its director won't say who is backing it.

articles.title: U.S. FBI intelligence agent arrested in connection with theft of $1 million in crypto
articles.snippet: The agent, who had "top secret" clearance and worked in FBI headquarters, was accused of taking crypto from wallets the agency had investigated.
